basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old tech enthusiast from Seattle, WA, with a passion for virtual reality and aviation. I work as a software developer for a VR gaming company and enjoy testing out new VR hardware and software in my free time. I love traveling and often share my flying experiences on Reddit. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, from around 7 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry, particularly in the field of virtual reality, for the past four years. I keep up with the latest trends through online courses and tech forums. My interest in aviation is more of a hobby, fueled by self-teaching and occasional flying lessons.
